text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 奶油白黑色细波点抹胸束身上衣及匹配修身迷你裙，白色细跟鞋保守补全。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue image, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, realistic fabric/construction. Portrait 2:3; entire objects fully visible with comfortable margins. No text, watermark, people, skin, body parts, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, support or scene. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation, no skin-colored filling in stockings. Preserve exact visible color, silhouette, pattern and details. Conservatively reconstruct occluded details without adding decoration. The ONLY target is the 下排中 outfit in the reference (Chinese position; 上排左=top left, 上排中=top center, 上排右=top right, 下排左=bottom left, 下排中=bottom center, 下排右=bottom right, 左=left, 右=right, 整图=single outfit). Ignore every other panel. GARMENTS AND FOOTWEAR ONLY: 奶油白黑色细波点抹胸束身上衣及匹配修身迷你裙，白色细跟鞋保守补全. Remove ALL detachable accessories, including 奶油白宽发箍；白色薄纱手套一对；奶油白珠柄小包；珍珠耳饰一对. Keep integral garment buttons, fasteners and sewn ties. Do not add any other item.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
